policy: Root owns all Git mutations, with GIT_INDEX_FILE set to the external shadow index and GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0. Default read-only Git follows the index link. Future default Git writes could replace that link; remeasure before further exports. No tracked scientific path is absent, skip-worktree, deleted or symlinked by this metadata operation. Original index bytes are preserved separately; original v2 backup and Git object pools remain.
